audit_scope: Saved configuration, code, split manifest, and selected checkpoints; no training or new model evaluation.

checks.evidence: Final checkpoint first convolution shape is (16, 5, 3, 3); input channels=5.
Generalist input is normalized RGB concatenated with two zero channels.
Specialist input is cropped normalized RGB plus two decomposition channels; cropper is a deterministic label-free heuristic, not a trained segmenter.
Class-weighted focal term is multiplied by generalist-error and uncertainty weights.

Transfer is bounded by min(top off-pair margin, kappa*top probability), gated by feasibility, alpha and melanoma preference, subtracted from the strongest off-pair class and added to MEL, then renormalized.
The final bundle model_state is bytewise tensor-equal to stage3_finetune_best model_state.

_head_validation uses no_grad but does not call eval(); Stage 1/2 heads remain in train mode, so dropout was active during recorded validation and checkpoint selection. Deterministic post-hoc Stage 2 results must replace the logged rate in reporting.
A0/A1/A3/A4 have full-run outputs. A2 and A5 exist only as smoke ablations and must not be presented as full ablation results.
The supplied HAM10000 manifest contains lesion IDs but no patient identifier; patient-level disjointness cannot be verified.

blocking_reporting_rules: Describe the specialist crop as deterministic heuristic localization, not a learned segmentation model.
Use deterministic post-hoc checkpoint metrics for Stage 2; label original dropout-active validation values as defective logs.
Do not claim full A2 or A5 ablations.
